content.text: Production-ready 2D pixel art for a fixed-camera three-quarter top-down dark fantasy dungeon game. Match the supplied Overbless pixel-art references: crisp hard pixel clusters, readable silhouette at 128 pixels, dark navy outlines, restrained cyan/purple/orange accents, no antialiasing, no blur, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Use a perfectly flat pure magenta #ff00ff background around every isolated object. Create a strict 4-column by 3-row sprite sheet with twelve separate isolated dungeon mechanic assets, one centered in each equal cell with wide magenta gutters. Three-quarter top-down pixel art matching the reference dungeon. Row 1: 1) seamless cliff-edge floor tile with a clear safe stone lip and black-blue void below; 2) cliff inner-corner tile; 3) cracked destructible stone pillar intact with bright readable fissures; 4) same pillar heavily damaged. Row 2: 5) destroyed pillar rubble pile; 6) spike trap inactive and flush with floor; 7) same spike trap warning with partially raised spikes and amber rune; 8) same spike trap active with fully raised spikes. Row 3: 9) broken wall rubble; 10) fractured dungeon floor tile; 11) final-room dark stone floor tile with restrained purple inlay; 12) open exit pedestal with cyan-gold core. Keep collision silhouettes unambiguous. Every cell exactly one asset, no text, no borders, no labels.
